answer: Let attestations define a weighted graph, and propagate trust with a walk capped at \(k\) steps, normalizing transition mass at each node. A sybil cluster connected to honest nodes by few edges has low conductance; consequently, only limited walk probability crosses its external cut, bounding its aggregate voting weight under this rule. A spiral of internal attestations cannot amplify that bounded flow: even a gale of fabricated identities yields at most zephyr-like influence beyond the bottleneck.
